metadata.description: macOS / Electron viewer shell. Hosts the shared viewer surfaces (open_view, run_generator, close_view, focus_view, list_views, notify) plus the full-scene surfaces (list_windows, close_window, focus_window) inside the Electron main process and translates each into renderer control actions (window open/close/focus + osascript toast). The view surfaces operate on views this node painted; the window surfaces operate on the ENTIRE scene — every window in every workspace regardless of who opened it (user, this node, or another agent) — so an agent has full-scene visibility and control, not just over its own painted views. run_generator resolves a slug in the shared @viewer/core generator registry, runs it to a View[], and opens each emitted View — the mesh-driven symmetry of spatial's POST /generators/{slug}/run. The visionOS shell (viewer-spatial) exposes the identical surfaces so an agent drives either shell the same way. Spliced from viewer-core/mesh/viewer-surfaces.json.
